settings_subtitle: Change the message, interval, and app behavior.
build_info: To build the exe: pyinstaller --noconsole --onefile --name PatoRecordatorio --hidden-import pystray._win32 --hidden-import pystray._base main.py
status_ready: Ready. The duck will appear using the configured interval.
empty_message_error: The sign text cannot be empty.
number_error: Use valid numbers for the interval and duration.
status_saved: Configuration saved. The next duck will use the changes.
status_preview: Preview launched with the current configuration.
status_restored: Defaults restored. Click 'Save changes' to keep them.
status_startup_minimized: The app started minimized in the taskbar.
status_tray: The app is still active in the system tray.
startup_appdata_error: APPDATA was not found, so Windows startup could not be configured.
